items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: With that band, you remember what kind of music you used to play with that band, with Teat and Steve Angle?

ctx.x: How come you never called yourself, how come you called Kid Thomas and not Kid Valentine? Well, I went...

People just tried to call me that now. You know, very few people, they don't never know my right name, you know. Everybody used to call me Kid, everybody. And people be surprised, they say, man, I didn't know you only did this. You know what I mean? All them years, you know what I'm talking about? No, I never did, they never know. But they always called me Kid, you know me. With that band, you remember what kind of music you used to play with that band, with Teat and Steve Angle? What kind of music would you play…
Ragtime, jazz. Never, we never stopped playing jazz. I mean, did you play from music in that band? Yeah. Did you play from music in that band? Had music. You mean we had music? Yeah.
